new_results.statement: For every row-marginal cap 1/2<=h<1 and every 2h<r<2, a physical scalar pivot d plus an entropy-weighted Schur E2 minor law gives ||p_Q||inf <= C(h,r)|d|^-1/2 K_2(mu)^-1/8.

At h=.67,r=1.74,KL<=log4, either ||p_Q||inf <=17.086318 |d|^-1/2 E2^-1/8 or at most two row hubs and two column hubs jointly carry more than half of E2 minor mass; one hub pair has exact aggregate star currency >E2/8.

For N=S+xy^T with E0=E2(N), either a diffuse surviving Schur block gives ||p_Q||inf <=20.319171 |d|^-1/2 E0^-1/8, or <=2x2 hubs carry >E0/8 surviving mass, or the exact account02/B13 transverse-star currency exceeds E0/4.

For every h<1, an invertible indefinite original-coordinate pair with least singular value kappa plus an entropy-weighted Schur E2 law gives an L-infinity bound. At h=.67,r=1.74,KL<=log4 the constant is 96.654811 kappa^-1/2 E2^-1/8, or the survivor is <=2x2 hubs.

For scalar-pivot slab ratio R, recursive two-hub descent yields operator distance <=291.943/(R^2|d|) to rank <=4k+2. Pair-pivot version yields rank <=4k_pair+3 with error <9342.16/(R^2 kappa); retain the older three-hub pair version when residual accuracy matters.

partner_result_actually_applied.application: Combined sqrt(E0)<=sqrt(E)+D_* with the new h<1 diffuse payment to prove the survive/two-hub/transverse-star trichotomy at explicit scales.

extremal_product_reduction: For every bounded nonnegative kernel K, the supremum over cap-one product densities equals the supremum over arbitrary measure-one product indicators, by iterated one-coordinate bathtub; no interval or centered-uniform reduction is asserted.
first_unpaid_statement: Convert the finite two-by-two physical hub packet or exact transverse-star currency into an already-paid grouped-bank/rank-three/mixed-row mechanism while preserving original-coordinate product provenance; do not perturbatively delete the small operator tail on arbitrary translated fragmented supports.
